title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Death: rhetoric and evidence
prompt: Answer each question in two or three complete sentences. Quote the text to support your answers.

items.prompt: Henry compares hope to "the song of that siren." What does this comparison suggest about the hopes of the men he is answering, and how does it help him persuade?
Henry says he has "but one lamp," the "lamp of experience." What does he conclude from the past ten years? Quote one piece of evidence he uses.
Henry asks a series of questions, such as "Shall we try argument?" Why does he answer them himself, and what effect does this have on his audience?
